AI-Powered Sales CRM Built Around Your Business

An AI CRM keeps every enquiry, quote and call in one place, then does the heavy reading for you. It scores leads, flags risky deals and drafts summaries, so anyone on your team can pick up a conversation with full context.  

For UAE businesses, that means English and Arabic customers, fast-moving deals and several branches, all working from one version of the truth. 

HAMT Infotech has worked with UAE and GCC businesses for 26 years, and delivers enterprise CRM software on SugarAI or a custom-made CRM, from the first workshop to support. 

Features

AI Features That Work Inside Your CRM

AI Lead and Opportunity Scoring

Every lead is scored the moment it is created, using your own won and lost history, so reps call the best prospects first.

At-Risk Deal Alerts

AI flags deals losing momentum, so managers step in while there is still time to save them.

AI Sales Forecasting

Built-in forecasting shows which deals are most likely to close, giving leaders a clearer view of the quarter.

AI-Drafted Summaries and Meeting Prep

Account summaries and meeting prep are drafted automatically, so reps stop assembling context by hand.

Next-Best-Action Guidance

Reps get a clear next step for every account, so the CRM acts like a coach, not an archive.

AI That Works With Incomplete Data

Predictions stay useful even when records are partial, so you see value from day one.

FAQ

AI CRM Software: Frequently Asked Questions

What is AI CRM software, and how is it different from a standard CRM? 

A standard CRM stores and organises customer data. AI CRM software also uses it: it scores leads, flags deals at risk, forecasts what will close, drafts account summaries and suggests the next best action.  

What AI features does an AI-powered sales CRM include? 

Our AI-powered sales CRM on SugarAI includes lead and opportunity scoring trained on your own won and lost history, at-risk deal alerts, built-in forecasting, drafted summaries and meeting prep, and next-best-action guidance.  

What is SugarAI, and how is it different from Sugar CRM? 

SugarAI is the intelligent evolution of Sugar CRM. It keeps the sales, service and marketing platform and adds built-in predictive AI that scores leads, flags at-risk deals and drafts account summaries automatically.  

Can SugarAI work if our customer data is incomplete? 

Yes. SugarAI is built to give useful predictions from partial or ageing records, so you do not need a perfect database before you start.  

Can you connect the CRM to our ERP and other systems? 

Yes. We connect SugarAI with ERP and finance platforms, your website, email and marketing tools, so data moves between systems automatically and the AI works from complete records.  

Can we keep our data in the UAE or on our own servers? 

Yes. You can host on the cloud with regional hosting, deploy into your own Azure, AWS or Oracle Cloud subscription, or install on-premise in your own data centre. Groups often mix models, and it is the same product and team either way.
